title: Conference paper review workspace

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: The submission is invented and sits at the top of the script, where the reviewer meant to paste the real paper text. The recommendation scale and checklist are the reviewer's paraphrase of the venue's guidelines, not a copy of any real form. The draft, quotes and checklist are kept in the browser's localStorage on the reviewer's own laptop.
